problem: 3524. Find X Value of Array I
pattern: Rolling remainder counts for all subarrays ending at current position; add singleton then extend prior endings and accumulate totals.
adaptation_notes: k>0 and nonnegative values under source contract. O(nk) time and O(k) state; 64-bit counts already used.

pattern: Initialize first row/column; each cell cost plus min(top,left).
adaptation_notes: Nonempty rectangular grid assumption; widen path sum for expanded values. Rolling row is optional documented space optimization, source stores full table.

problem: 1621. Number of Sets of K Non-Overlapping Line Segments
pattern: Memoize point index, remaining segment count, and whether a segment is open; close at same point to permit shared endpoints.
adaptation_notes: Fixed huge member array and recursion depth should become dynamically sized or rolling state in generalized code. k==0 base represents all requested segments completed. Modulo constant use integer literal.

problem: 4058. Maximum Pulse Value After One Subarray Rotation
pattern: Alternating base sum plus best nonnegative segment gain over each adjacent-pair parity.
adaptation_notes: This is problem-specific gain derivation; generalized template is Kadane over transformed pair gains. Preserve 2LL widening.

pattern: Frequency buckets lowered from largest difference to zero; batches identical greedy moves.
adaptation_notes: Use 1LL*k1+k2 before addition if bounds expand; difference subtraction and abs also need widening for unrestricted ints. Runtime O(n+maxDiff), not O(n log n).

pattern: Sort by end, retain earliest finishing compatible interval and count removals.
adaptation_notes: Replace auto& last = intervals[0] with scalar lastEnd or value to avoid mutating intervals[0]. Guard empty input in reusable helper. Sorting mutates input unless copied.

pattern: Sort then fold into result.back(), extending overlapping intervals.
adaptation_notes: State endpoint semantics: touching endpoints merge. Input sorted in place.

pattern: Find overlapping block with lower_bound on interval ends and upper_bound on interval starts; erase and insert merged interval.
adaptation_notes: Requires sorted disjoint intervals so endpoints are monotone. Vector erase/insert remains O(n), despite O(log n) searches. Mutates both intervals and newInterval; value-copy new interval for a reusable nonmutating interface.

pattern: Initialize all ones, enforce increasing-neighbor constraints left-to-right and right-to-left with max.
adaptation_notes: Use signed n before n-2; widen total if bounds expand. Explain independent directional lower bounds.

pattern: Process bits from high to low; refine active prefix groups into ones then zeros, freezing groups after first zero block.
adaptation_notes: 15-bit nonnegative input bound is hard-coded. Preserve as a specialized pattern, not an unrestricted sorting theorem without proof from problem contract.

problem: 2472. Maximum Number of Non-overlapping Palindrome Substrings
pattern: Scan left-to-right checking only length k and k+1 palindromes, take first qualifying block, jump past it.
adaptation_notes: Cast string size before subtracting k; unsigned s.size()-k can underflow when k>n. Explain why longer palindromes can be reduced to k or k+1 and why earliest finish is safe.

pattern: Sort intervals by end; precompute last strictly compatible predecessor; DP over allowed count<=4 and prefix, preserving score and lexicographically smallest original-index path.
adaptation_notes: Input is mutated by appending index and sorting; use copy for reusable API. Generalize K explicitly and account for path-copy/sort cost as K grows. Strict nonoverlap differs from touching-allowed scheduling.

pattern: Collect each character first/last/count in first-appearance order; deque suffix aggregation checks whether contained character counts exactly fill its bounding interval, emits then clears.
adaptation_notes: Specialized nonstandard greedy implementation; requires a proof or differential tests before promoting as a generic interval-closure template. Alphabet limited to lowercase and q bounded by 26. Do not substitute standard closure algorithm while claiming exact source.

pattern: Disjoint interval map by start; lower_bound identifies successor, predecessor checks other possible conflict.
adaptation_notes: Half-open intervals [start,end), so touching allowed. Require start<end. O(log n) insertion/query.

pattern: Encode start positive and end negative, order same-x events descending signed height, maintain max active height, emit changes.
adaptation_notes: Erase one found iterator, not all equal heights. Explain event tie order: taller starts before shorter, shorter ends before taller, starts before ends.

problem: 121. Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
pattern: Track lowest price so far and best sell-minus-minimum profit.
adaptation_notes: Single transaction, later-or-same sale; widened difference for expanded bounds.

problem: 1877. Minimize Maximum Pair Sum in Array
pattern: Pair smallest with largest, maximizing pair sum over pairs.
adaptation_notes: Bucket-map version scans entire numeric range O(n+max-min), not O(n). Nonnegative assumptions affect initial result=0; even length required.

pattern: Key maps to ordered timestamp/value map; upper_bound then predecessor finds most recent <=timestamp.
adaptation_notes: Read get inserts missing outer key via []; use find for const semantics. Older insert keeps existing timestamp, latest assignment overwrites; document chosen contract.

pattern: Latest keeps stack per frequency and per-value frequency; pop last value at highest frequency. Older maintains ordered set by (-frequency,-latest_timestamp,value).
adaptation_notes: Preferred bucket form expected O(1), ordered-set form O(log distinct). pop requires nonempty. Keep historical lower-frequency entries; they encode recency after pops, not stale entries to remove.

pattern: Push operands, pop right then left for binary operator.
adaptation_notes: Operand order matters for subtraction/division. Valid expression/nonzero divisor assumed; stoi offers better failure visibility than atoi.

pattern: Store minimum-so-far beside each value or in parallel stack.
adaptation_notes: All read/pop operations require nonempty; paired-vector form keeps correlated state together.

pattern: Push into spare queue then move old queue behind it; swap so front is newest.
adaptation_notes: Push O(n), pop/top O(1); empty precondition on pop/top.

pattern: Input stack for push; transfer all to output stack only when output empty.
adaptation_notes: Amortized O(1), individual transfer O(n); peek/pop require nonempty queue.

pattern: Maintain score history with cancel/double/sum-of-last-two commands.
adaptation_notes: Valid-operation preconditions; use indexed back entries instead of temporary pop if cleaning code. Final sum can avoid destructive drain.

pattern: Latest frequency->list buckets and key->iterator map use MRU-front/LRU-back within a frequency, tracking minFreq. Older ordered set sorts (frequency,time,key,value).
adaptation_notes: Zero capacity handled. Copying object with iterator maps requires deleted copy or correct rebuild; prefer list::splice for node promotion as optional adaptation, source erase/copy is valid. minFreq increments when emptied minimum bucket during promotion; reset to1 on insertion.

pattern: Store append-only posts by user; scan followed and own posts into size-10 min heap, reverse output.
adaptation_notes: Actual feed retrieval scans all relevant historical posts; not k-way merge. Prevent or ignore self-follow to avoid duplicating own posts if generic API permits it. Long-lived counter width and bounded retention need explicit new requirements.

pattern: Fixed 32 buckets, each list of key/value pairs; scan chain for upsert/get/remove.
adaptation_notes: Fixed bucket count means operations degrade to O(n); do not advertise expected O(1) under growth. Keep bounded educational template or add rehash/load factor as explicitly new adaptation. Positive-key assumption; size_t conversion of negative key is not signed mathematical modulo. Missing sentinel -1 cannot represent arbitrary values unambiguously.

pattern: List MRU-front/LRU-back with key->iterator map; splice hit to front, evict back when full.
adaptation_notes: Add capacity==0 guard: source back() on empty otherwise. Iterator-bearing object needs deleted copy or custom rebuilt copy. Splice within list preserves iterator.

pattern: XOR all values and return zero-XOR or even parity.
adaptation_notes: Handbook must include the game invariant proof; no simulation or DP in code.

pattern: Map lowercase character to reverse alphabet weight and multiply by one-based index.
adaptation_notes: Remove debug cout from older source; fixed lowercase alphabet.

pattern: Positive-area rectangle intersection equals strict overlap on both axes.
adaptation_notes: Symmetric second call is redundant; use logical && and one check. Assumes normalized rectangle coordinates.

pattern: Closest rectangle point to circle center obtained by clamping both coordinates; compare squared distance.
adaptation_notes: Widen differences and products before squaring. Boundaries inclusive, touching counts.

pattern: For every pair of nonzero pixel coordinates, count translation vector; maximum frequency is best overlap.
adaptation_notes: Cast both signed differences through uint32_t before packing; this safely preserves 32-bit bit patterns. Complexity O(number_of_ones_A * number_of_ones_B).

pattern: Sort, walk distinct value triples using frequencies, add product/choose2/choose3 multiplicities.
adaptation_notes: State distinct-index versus distinct-value distinction. Products need wide type before multiplication; sorted input mutated.

problem: 1498. Number of Subsequences That Satisfy the Given Sum Condition
pattern: Sort; when minimum+maximum fits, all subsets of interior elements yield 2^(right-left) valid subsequences with fixed minimum.
adaptation_notes: Use constexpr integer modulus rather than pow; widen min+max for arbitrary ints. Explain indices distinguish duplicate values.

pattern: Enumerate hundreds,tens,even units using decrement/restore counts, avoiding leading zero and duplicate values.
adaptation_notes: Fixed 3-digit universe, not a generic permutation generator.

pattern: Each decimal comma threshold contributes max(0,n-threshold+1); five hardcoded powers of 1000.
adaptation_notes: Finite hardcoded thresholds depend on problem range; general loop needs overflow-safe multiplication.

pattern: Counts numbers at first comma threshold under original small range.
adaptation_notes: Loop also divides n while multiplying i, so it is not a correct unrestricted multicomma-range template. Use verified threshold formula from 3871 if generalizing.

pattern: Scan minimum odd and even; return all-even or minimum odd below minimum even.
adaptation_notes: Source comments give incorrect parity arithmetic and must not be copied; without task-specific operation proof this is a specialized observation, not a general parity transformation rule.

pattern: Actual implementation returns true for every input.
adaptation_notes: No reusable code beyond the problem theorem; do not invent a generic parity algorithm from this source.

pattern: Generate odd/even palindromic roots by mirroring half, square them, and test numeric palindrome in target range.
adaptation_notes: Half-bound 1e5 is problem-specific. Multiplication can overflow for larger root bounds; guard via division or wider type. Zero would be generated twice if range permitted zero.
